purpose: Research-only segment-versus-operating MIC caveat; avoid assigning an execution segment from an operating MIC.

authorities.finding: SWIFT ISO10383 official publication 2026-11-09 with modifications effective 2026-11-23; workbook data not freshly parsed.
AFM handbook distinguishes XETR operator from actual market segments, giving XETA and XETB as examples; historical guidance, not a live instrument segment mapping.
Euronext states segment MICs can sit beneath operating MICs and dark-book MICs must not be treated as ordinary instrument listings.
Euronext eligibility document uses XAMS, XETR, XHEL at broad market classification level, not proof of actual transaction segment.

admission_rule: Do not infer segment MIC from exchange operator MIC, ticker suffix, general market classification, or broker tariff category. Require per-instrument venue/segment evidence and broker route confirmation.
limitations: AFM handbook is historical; cannot prove present-day exact segment.
Official ISO workbook bytes and effective records not freshly verified.
No broker execution confirmations or account quotes.
